description: Organic performance on Bing (Bing Webmaster Tools, weekly data) for the property: view=traffic gives weekly clicks/impressions with totals and change vs the previous same-length window; view=queries or view=pages gives the top keys with clicks, impressions, impression-weighted position, previous-period values and growth/decline sorting. Period is in whole weeks ending on the last synced Bing week (default 12 weeks). A property without Bing returns no_data with the panel URL where Bing is connected; hasBing in list_sites tells which properties have it. Use for "how do we do on Bing", Bing vs Google query overlap, Copilot-era visibility. / Bing: tráfego semanal, queries e páginas com comparação.

compare.description: previous (default) = the same number of weeks before; none.

contains.description: queries/pages: only keys containing this text.

endWeek.description: Last week_start (Monday-based date as stored) to include; default = latest synced.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: get_bing_performance
title: Bing Webmaster performance
